_comment: The ART palette — what kindling/tools/cut.mjs's `fit --palette` snaps a generated sprite to. Deliberately NOT turf/js/palette.js: that PAL object is the whole UI+terrain+HUD palette (30+ colours, most of them floor tiles and HP-bar greys that a character sprite has no business touching). This is just the sixteen a Metal-Slug-Tactics-register sprite actually draws with — ink, two skin tones, three neutral-streetwear tones shared by both factions, the cold operator ramp, the warm enemy ramp, and two metal tones for a blade/barrel. Magenta is never listed here: by the time `fit` runs, `key` has already turned it into alpha, so it is not a colour the sprite's opaque pixels should ever land on.
